svg.title: Graphite response: baseline and hot conditions on the same axes
svg.desc: Blue is baseline; orange is hot. Solid measured bands are digitized from the original figures. Dashed model curves are reconstructed using the reported one-dimensional model. The hot fitted heat flux is 2.25 times baseline. At 3 seconds, the model curves differ by about 22.1 degrees Celsius. Original fit RMSE is 1.02 degrees for baseline and 3.02 for hot.
svg.text: Baseline vs. hot: one shared temperature scale
Graphite back-face temperature rise · nominal 3 s flame exposure
